zh:
伦敦大学学院（University College London，简称UCL）成立于1826年，位于英国伦敦市中心，是伦敦大学联盟的创校成员，也是英国规模最大、学科覆盖最广的综合性公立研究型大学。学校采用书院联邦制，下设11个学院，在校生超42000人，是英国学生人数最多的大学之一。
UCL在医学、法学、经济学、人文社科、工程技术等领域均有卓越表现，诞生了34位诺贝尔奖得主、3位菲尔兹奖得主、2位图灵奖得主，教学理念强调跨学科研究与创新思维培养。2026QS世界大学排名中，伦敦大学学院位列世界第9位。
en: University College London (UCL) is a public research university in central London, England. Founded in 1826, UCL is a founding member of the University of London, and the largest and most academically diverse university in the UK. The University comprises 11 faculties, with over 42,000 enrolled students, making it one of the UK's largest universities by student population. UCL has produced 34 Nobel Prize winners, 3 Fields Medalists, and 2 Turing Award winners, excelling in medicine, law, economics, humanities, social sciences, and engineering, with a teaching philosophy focused on interdisciplinary research and innovative thinking. Ranked No.9 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
